description: Registry of all skills with canonical paths and ownership. Generated indexes and routing tables should derive from here. Do not maintain separate skill lists in prompt files.
note_on_duplication: ops/automation/skills/ is the canonical source for shared operational skills. ICN-level skills are canonical under .agents/skills/. Provider-facing .claude/skills copies are compatibility mirrors/adapters, not independent owners. Project-level .claude/skills for {status, sync-and-build, worktree} MUST be symlinks to ops/automation/skills/. Run ops/scripts/setup-skill-symlinks.sh to create/verify project-level symlinks.

ops_automation_canonical.name: sync-and-build
ops_automation_canonical.description: Website build pipeline — no sync script needed

overlapping_ownership_notes.fix-ci: Both ICN- and project-level surfaces may expose this workflow. .agents/skills/fix-ci is authoritative for ICN-specific CI work; live failure logs and policy.json supply current facts.
overlapping_ownership_notes.icn-preflight: Both ICN- and provider/project-level surfaces may expose preflight. .agents/skills/icn-preflight is authoritative; provider copies must preserve its owner-driven bootstrap semantics.
overlapping_ownership_notes.merge-prs: Both ICN- and project-level surfaces may expose merging. .agents/skills/merge-prs is authoritative for ICN and MUST load required checks/strategy dynamically from ops/state/truth/policy.json and live branch protection rather than hardcoding a check count.
